card: Fixes a daemon assertion crash in `dumptxoutset` on pruned nodes using assumeutxo. When `dumptxoutset` with rollback is called right after `loadtxoutset`, it invokes `GetFirstBlock` on a tip block that has not yet downloaded block or undo data, triggering an assertion failure in `blockstorage.cpp`. The patch verifies the tip has data first and returns the standard pruned data error instead of aborting.
evidence: PR description reproduces the crash and quotes the exact assertion failure: `Assertion failed: ((last_block->nStatus & status_mask) == status_mask), function GetFirstBlock, file blockstorage.cpp, line 638.`
problem: After loading an assumeutxo snapshot via `loadtxoutset`, the active tip is the snapshot base block and lacks downloaded block and undo data. On a pruned node, invoking `dumptxoutset` with a `rollback` argument passes this tip to `GetFirstBlock`, which asserts that the starting block has block and undo data, causing `bitcoind` to crash.

risk.why: A flaw in the pre-check could prematurely reject valid dumptxoutset rollback requests or fail to prevent the assertion abort.

scope_notes: Small fix modifying the rollback check in `blockchain.cpp` and adding a regression test to `test/functional/feature_assumeutxo.py`.
summary: Fix an assertion failure crash when running `dumptxoutset` with the `rollback` option on a pruned node immediately following `loadtxoutset`. The check verifies that the active tip has block and undo data before invoking `GetFirstBlock`, returning an RPC error instead of aborting the daemon.
